vulnerability.name: USN-9113-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that LilyPond did not restrict the embedded-ps and embedded-svg commands when running in safe mode. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a specially crafted file in safe mode, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: LilyPond could be made to run programs if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
